player_season_leader_and_awards.rederivation_notes: MY CHAIN (written before reading the record): the evidence ledger shows 46 series of which I counted 30 are KX*FTTS 'First Team to Score' match-level contracts (YES if the named team records the first goal of the entire game incl. ET; own goal credited to the team awarded it), plus ~16 season/leader/award series (KXEPLSEASONSTAT '14+ goals across all games during the 2026-27 EPL season', KX*LEADER, Golden Boot, POY, Ballon d'Or). Season stat: tally to date -> remaining fixtures -> availability/minutes survival -> team chance volume x player share x finishing + penalties -> overdispersed count vs integer rung. Leader: correlated max over candidates with unknown tie rule. Awards: voter/narrative/trophy process, not a count. FTTS: independent competing risks, P(team A first)=lambdaA/(lambdaA+lambdaB)*(1-exp(-(lambdaA+lambdaB))) for 90 min, plus extra-time branch and an undefined no-goal outcome; inputs are team lambdas, lineups, set-piece/penalty first-goal tendencies, early-goal timing. DIFFERENCES: the author found the mis-bucketing and the leader/stat mechanism (survival minutes, share, finishing shrinkage, order statistic) closely matches mine, but gave the 30-series FTTS majority zero inputs and even marked the team-level inputs it needs (soc.xg, soc.lineups_pit) as DUPLICATE/WEAK; award voting has no data source; a few interactions and numbers are weak.

findings.text: 30 of the 46 live series (65%) are KX*FTTS match-level contracts, but the record says 'about 25' and supplies no input list for them: stage s5/s6 only gestures at them. Their drivers (both teams' goal intensities, early-goal tendency, set-piece/penalty first-goal share, confirmed XI) are absent, and the audit rates soc.lineups_pit WEAK ('matter for single matches, not for a season-long total') and soc.xg DUPLICATE_OF soc.player_xg, which is exactly backwards for FTTS where team xG and lineups are primary. The archetype's input list therefore cannot be relied on for most of its series; FTTS needs re-keying to a match-level archetype or its own mechanism and inputs.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Corrected the count (30 of 46, not about 25), logged all 30 FTTS tickets in series_mapping_issues as belonging to first_to_score_event, scoped this record's inputs to the 16 non-FTTS series in variants, and fixed the soc.xg audit (team xG kept secondary and cited in s2); FTTS inputs stay in the other record.

findings.text: FTTS settlement for a game with no goal (0-0 after 90, or 0-0 after ET into penalties) is not visible in the sampled rules and is not listed in 'unresolved'; the record instead asserts that a 0-0 after 90 'decided by an ET goal still has a first scorer' and says nothing about 0-0 overall. Whether a goalless game resolves No for both teams is decisive for the lambda-ratio formula and should be CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:ftts_no_goal_settlement

findings.text: soc.award_voting_narrative (voted awards: KXBALLONDOR, KXSUPERBALLONDOR, KXEPLPOY, KXPFAPOY, KXWCAWARD/COMBO) has no required_data entry at all; the only dataset that lists it as a feed is 'Rules and settlement text versions', which cannot produce past winners, shortlists, voter composition, trophy outcomes or ceremony dates. The same dataset also lists soc.remaining_schedule_strength as fed by rules text, which is a mapping error. A data requirement (historical winners/finalists, tournament results, voting rules by award) is missing.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added an award-results/shortlists/tournament-outcomes/voting-rules required_data row feeding soc.award_voting_narrative, and removed soc.award_voting_narrative and soc.remaining_schedule_strength from the rules-text feeds; added a fixture/opponent-strength row for soc.remaining_schedule_strength.

findings.text: Audit verdicts are internally inconsistent with the stages: soc.xg is DUPLICATE_OF soc.player_xg although team-level xG (team chance volume) is the first factor of the expected-goals product the record itself writes in the summary ('team chance volume x player's share'); only team_goal_share_competition re-uses team npxG implicitly. Player xG/90 and team xG are not duplicates.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: soc.xg audit changed from DUPLICATE_OF soc.player_xg to KEEP_SECONDARY (team chance volume is the first factor of the product and differs from player xG/90) and the input is now attached to stage s2; the duplicate claim was wrong.

findings.text: KXEPLSEASONSTAT ticker '27GOAL-YWISSA9-14' implies a family of season stats (GOAL and probably other stat codes); the record treats it as goals only and does not flag that assists/other stats may be listed, nor that 'across all games during the 2026-27 EPL season' could mean league-only or all competitions (it does flag the latter).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added to variants that the ticker code GOAL implies a family of season stats, that only goals are treated as verified, and that the league-only versus all-competitions scope remains unresolved under leader_tiebreak_unknown.

findings.text: Interaction 4 (penalty_taker_status x remaining_schedule_strength, 'threshold') is not a threshold: it is a product of taker flag and team penalty rate; the claimed 'about 0.1 goals per match' only holds at roughly 0.15 team penalties per match. Interaction 1 (minutes survival x share) is just the factorization of the mean, not an interaction; the claim that the 14+ rung is crossed 'with a lower probability than the mean suggests' is only true when the mean is above the rung.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Interaction 4 relabelled multiplicative with the arithmetic stated (0.15 penalties x 0.78 conversion = about 0.1 goals/match) and interaction 1 rewritten to say the exceedance effect depends on mean versus rung and to state it is a factorisation, not a free interaction.

findings.text: Unsupported numerics presented as fact: finishing persistence 'about 20-30%', k about 100 shots, 'gap under 2 goals near-linear, beyond 5 collapses'. They should be marked as to-be-estimated, not as established.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Relabelled the 20-30% finishing persistence, the 2/5-goal gap breakpoints and k about 100 shots as placeholders to be estimated in stage s3 and nonlinearities 2 and 3.

findings.text: '44 of 46 series are TITLE_ONLY' conflicts with the evidence pack, where only one live series (KXEPLSEASONSTAT) is RULES_TEXT; the FTTS sample came from a series flagged TITLE_ONLY, so the count of verified series is unclear. Minor bookkeeping, but the rules_verification of PARTIALLY_VERIFIED rests on one season-stat sample and one FTTS sample.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Corrected the verified-series bookkeeping: 2 of 46 series have sampled rules (KXEPLSEASONSTAT and KXAFCCLFTTS, the latter flagged TITLE_ONLY in the ledger) in the variants and bucket_heterogeneity text, and stated what PARTIALLY_VERIFIED rests on.

relegation_qualification_advancement.rederivation_notes: MY CHAIN (before reading the record): three families sit here. (a) Final-table position events (KX*LAST 'finishes in last place in the league table', RELEGATION, TOP/TOP2/TOP4/TOP6, EFLPROMO): current points + remaining fixture simulation with posterior strengths, tiebreak order of the competition, points deductions; cut line fixed by table rank unless contract text says qualification. (b) Advancement (KX*ADVANCE 'advance past X in the ... tie'): legs, aggregate state, ET, penalties, single- vs two-leg format, national cups and ~100 worldwide leagues/cups. (c) National-team and tournament events (WC group qualifiers/winner/bottom, WCADVANCE, Nations League, Euro/WC qualifiers, UCL league-phase top 8, Ballon d'Or rank, FIFA top 10): group/seeding structure and national-team strength. Required inputs: ratings + uncertainty for the right population, fixtures, tiebreak rules, shock events. DIFFERENCES: the author's season-simulation and tie-tree mechanisms match mine; I disagree that the cut line is random for TOP-N (titles say 'Top 4 Finishers' = rank), the european_slot_spillover input is mislabelled primary on inference, national-team and non-European rating sources are missing, and several non-table series (rank-of-award, FIFA ranking) are unaddressed.

findings.text: soc.european_slot_spillover is labelled primary and drives Stage s3 plus interaction 1 ('a fifth-placed team's top-4 probability is a step function of whether a domestic cup winner is already qualified'). No sampled rule and no live series title settles on European qualification: the series are KXEPLTOP4 'EPL top 4 teams', KXLIGUE1TOP4 'Top 4 Finishers', KXEPLTOP2/TOP6, KXUCLTOP8, i.e. table rank, TITLE_ONLY. Cup-winner spillover moves UEL/UECL places, not the 4th-place rank cut, so the claimed random cut line is an inference from titles and probably wrong for rank-based contracts. The settlement text for TOP-N must be CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS in 'unresolved', and the input should be demoted to context/secondary until a qualification-based series exists.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:topn_rank_vs_qualification

findings.text: Strength data covers only clubs: required_data cites ClubElo, football-data.co.uk, Transfermarkt. A large share of the 168 series are national-team or non-European: KXWCADVANCE, KXWCGROUPWIN/BOTTOM/QUAL, KXWCQUAL, KXUEFAEUROQUAL, KXUEFANL*, KXAFCONADVANCE, KXINTLFRIENDLYADVANCE, plus Asian, South American and North American leagues and cups (KXK2LEAGUEADVANCE, KXCHNSLADVANCE, KXIDNSLADVANCE, KXTHAIL1ADVANCE, KXAFCCLADVANCE, KXLIGAMXADVANCE, ...). No national-team rating source (e.g. World Football Elo, FIFA points) and no source of ratings for non-European leagues is listed or flagged SOURCE_UNVERIFIED, so the main primary input is undefined for those series.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:rating_source_coverage_nonclub

findings.text: Series that are not tie advancement or league finish at all are left unmapped and undiscussed: KXBALLONDORRANK (award ranking), KXWCFIFATOP10 (FIFA ranking formula), KXWCHOSTSTAGE and KXWCGROUPWINELIM (tournament path), KXUCLTOP8/KXUCLROUND (36-team league-phase table with unbalanced fixtures), KXEPLADVANCE/KXSERIEAADVANCE/KXLIGUE1ADVANCE (a league 'To Advance' with no obvious tie). Their mechanisms need FIFA ranking arithmetic, award-voting inputs or bracket simulation, none listed. At minimum these need CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS entries.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:unmapped_series_mechanisms

findings.text: Variants text cites tickers that are not in the live series of this archetype (KXUCLQUAL, 'KXBRASILEIROTOPX-style'); evidence shows KXUCLTOP8/KXUCLRO16/RO8/RO4/KXUCLROUND instead. The settlement claim 'extra time and penalties count if the tie format uses them' is an inference: only KXCONMEBOLLIBADVANCE and KXSERIECCUPADVANCE texts exist and both only say 'advance past'.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed tickers not live in this archetype (KXUCLQUAL, KXBRASILEIROTOPX-style) from variants and settlement text, replaced them with live TOP-N series, and reworded the extra-time/penalty claim as an inference since the two sampled texts say only "advance past".

findings.text: soc.last_place_extreme_value is an output of the same Monte Carlo (P(rank=N), gaps) that the audit uses to reject soc.stakes_leverage as 'circular'; the same standard should demote it, or stakes_leverage should be kept. soc.motivation is DUPLICATE_OF stakes_leverage yet is also what 'dead-rubber' rotation effects rely on, which no kept input captures.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Applied one standard: soc.last_place_extreme_value (a Monte Carlo output) demoted from secondary to context like the rejected stakes_leverage, and dead-rubber rotation now carried by soc.rotation_index attached to stage s2 and situational coverage, with its feed added.

findings.text: Interaction 5 (points_deductions x group_stage_scenarios, 'regime-switch') joins a league sanction with national-team group qualification; the stated mechanism (a deducted team becomes a dead rubber) is speculative and may be false for a team still fighting relegation. Nonlinearity 'Saturating in games remaining' contradicts its own text ('adds variance proportional to the number of games left'), which is linear then vanishing at the end.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Interaction 5 labelled speculative with the opposite-sign caveat for deducted teams still fighting relegation, and nonlinearity 1 shape corrected to linear-in-games-remaining then vanishing, matching its own text instead of "saturating".

findings.text: Hard numbers unsupported: 'sd about 0.1 log goals', '10-30% cup-spillover probability', 'trailing +20%, leader -10%' multipliers, '15 seasons of European second legs' as available data. These are placeholders to estimate, not facts; and away-goals treatment of national cups is left unresolved without a source.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Relabelled sd 0.1 log goals, 10-30% spillover and +20%/-10% state multipliers as placeholders to estimate, and stated that the 15-season tie history is unverified; away-goals rule history logged as unresolved away_goals_rule_history.

soccer_special_and_host.rederivation_notes: MY CHAIN (before reading the record): off-field one-shot events resolved by official announcement in a window. Types seen in the ledger: player leaves club (KXLAMINEYAMAL/KXCLUBCHANGEMBAPPE: permanent, any-duration loan, release/expiry/termination all count), next-club multi-outcome (KXJOINCLUB/RONALDO/SALAH/MBAPPE/SANE/DAVID incl. 'no change' and sign-and-loan rules), manager exits (KXPOCHETTINOOUT: effective date not announcement), host announcements (KXCOPAAMERICAHOST: any Source Agency, all co-hosts Yes), sanctions (KXMANCITYTITLES: EPL imposes stripping >=8 titles announced before 2028), retirements, and four World Cup host series that are really on-pitch outcomes (KXWCHOSTWIN, KXWCHOSTKO, KXWCHOSTSTAGE in the neighbouring key). Mechanism: reference-class hazard x actor state (contract end, release clause, buyer capacity) x calendar (windows, committee dates) x information tiers x legal stage. Required: contract/transfer data, buyer-side capacity, window calendars, manager results, process timelines, rules text. DIFFERENCES: the author's hazard/calendar/credibility/legal stages match mine closely and their quotes check out; they miss a destination-choice model for multi-outcome next-club sets and the on-pitch host-nation series, and assert one rule that is not in the text.

findings.text: No input models the destination: KXJOINCLUB, KXJOINRONALDO, KXJOINSALAH, KXJOINMBAPPE, KXJOINSANE, KXJOINDAVID, KXMLSJOIN, KXJOINLEAGUE are multi-outcome 'which club' markets. Stage s2 itself says a transfer needs 'a buyer that can afford the fee and wages', but all new inputs (contract expiry/release state, window calendar, dismissal hazard, procedure stage) are seller/player-side or timing; the existing soc.transfers is only net squad changes. A buyer-side input (club finances/PSR-FFP room, positional need, wage capacity, league and Saudi/MLS routes, player's stated preferences) and a normalisation across outcomes (including the 'currently at club / no change' outcome) are missing and are not disclosed in 'unresolved'.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added new input soc.destination_club_feasibility (buyer-side wage room, positional need, league route, preference, softmax over candidates including no change) to stage s2 with a club-finances required_data row; calibration limit logged as destination_normalisation_data.

findings.text: World Cup host-nation series KXWCHOSTWIN ('Host Nation to Win'), KXWCHOSTKO ('All Host Nations to Reach Knockout Round') (and KXWCHOSTSTAGE in the relegation key) sit in this 'off-field' archetype but settle on match results. The record frames the whole bucket as announcement hazards; these need team ratings, group/bracket simulation and the tournament state. Not flagged as mis-bucketed in variants or unresolved, so their required inputs (ratings, bracket sim) are absent.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:host_result_series_misfiled

findings.text: Settlement claim not supported by the text: variants say 'Sign-and-loan, contract-expiry release and transfers within the same group are all explicitly handled in the transfer series'. 'Transfers within the same group' does not appear in any sampled rules in the evidence pack (searched), so it is an invention or comes from unsampled text; the evidence rules_secondary are also truncated for KXJOINCLUB ('The mar...').
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Reviewer correct: removed the unsupported "transfers within the same group" claim from variants, replaced with what the sampled KXJOINCLUB, KXLAMINEYAMAL and KXJOINRONALDO texts actually say, and flagged same-group transfers as unaddressed and contract-ambiguous.

findings.text: KXMANCITYTITLES text reads 'If the English Premier League imposes a sanction stripping at least 8 title(s) across Premier League, FA Cup, or League Cup'. The record generalises to 'a governing-body sanction'; whether an FA/EFL/UEFA/CAS-driven stripping counts when the Premier League is not the imposing body is a CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS point not listed.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:sanction_imposing_body

findings.text: Interaction 4 and soc.points_deductions mix league points-deduction sanctions with titles-stripped legal outcomes; the points_deductions input is KEEP_CONTEXT but is fed as if it measures the Man City case. Interaction 3 (manager dismissal x window hazard) is a speculative cross-lag, not a mechanism supported by the contracts.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Clarified that soc.points_deductions covers league points deductions only (audit and interaction 4) with the titles-stripped outcome driven by soc.governance_procedure_stage, and labelled interaction 3 as an unsupported cross-lag hypothesis.

findings.text: Bucket includes non-professional or non-soccer-event series (KXUCLACOACH 'UCLA Next Coach', KXFIFAUSPULL/KXFIFAUSPULLGAME, KXUEFAISRAELBAN) with no rules; the base-rate and hazard inputs are generic for these, and the 34-of-41 TITLE_ONLY disclosure is the only caveat. Numerics like 'last 72 hours account for a large share of deals' are unsourced.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Logged KXUCLACOACH as not soccer in series_mapping_issues, noted in variants that KXFIFAUSPULL(GAME) and KXUEFAISRAELBAN have no rules and only loosely fit the generic hazard inputs, and removed the unsourced "last 72 hours" claim from stage s3.

team_points_and_margin.rederivation_notes: MY CHAIN (before reading the record): the only live series is KXWINSTREAKMANU (>=5 wins in a row across all competitions in calendar 2026, floor 4.5). Chain: results already played in 2026 and the live run length c0 (if a run of 5 already occurred the contract is decided) -> remaining 2026 fixtures in order across league, cups, Europe (about 8-12 matches left as of Nov 2026, not 25-35) -> per-match P(win) with draws and cup shootout classification -> rotation/congestion/injury regimes -> run-length dynamic programming with correlated strength uncertainty. Settlement hazards: what is a win in a cup tie (ET/penalties), whether friendlies count, whether wins before as-of count. Archetype name implies season points totals and margins; I expect those series elsewhere in the ledger, and I found KXEPLTEAMPOINTS, KXLALIGATEAMPOINTS, KXSERIEATEAMPOINTS, KXLIGUE1TEAMPOINTS, KXBUNDESLIGATEAMPOINTS filed under total_goals. DIFFERENCES: author's run-length mechanism and settlement ambiguities match; but the stated horizon is wrong for the market date, the claim that no season-points series exist in the ledger is false, and rotation is declared covered by an input that is not in the list.

findings.text: Archetype/series mis-mapping not detected: unresolved 'archetype_target_mismatch' and variants say 'no live series exists for season points totals ... in the ledger'. The ledger's total_goals key contains five season 'Team Points' series (KXEPLTEAMPOINTS, KXLALIGATEAMPOINTS, KXSERIEATEAMPOINTS, KXLIGUE1TEAMPOINTS, KXBUNDESLIGATEAMPOINTS). Those contracts need exactly this archetype's points_total_distribution/schedule machinery, but are being reviewed under goals-per-match inputs. The unmapped contracts mean this record's season-points inputs are untested against real contracts while real contracts get the wrong inputs; routing must be fixed or both records must flag it.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Logged the five Team Points series (KXEPLTEAMPOINTS, KXLALIGATEAMPOINTS, KXSERIEATEAMPOINTS, KXLIGUE1TEAMPOINTS, KXBUNDESLIGATEAMPOINTS) in series_mapping_issues as belonging here, and rewrote the settlement text, variants and archetype_target_mismatch so season-points claims are conditional on their (unseen) rules.

findings.text: Horizon misstated: stage s2 says 'number of remaining matches around 25-35 with cup survival random' and the variants talk of a season-long chance; market date is Nov 2026, so only roughly 8-12 fixtures remain in calendar 2026 and the run already accumulated since January is the dominant state. Current streak c0 appears only inside the measurement text of soc.fixture_sequence_win_vector; it is not its own required dataset, and the possibility that the 5-run has already occurred (market then settled or trivially YES) is not mentioned. Season-long figures ('1.3-2 times the independent calculation', 'p^5 about 0.05-0.08') are therefore misleading for the live contract.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Corrected the horizon to about 8-12 remaining fixtures for a November 2026 as-of date, removed the season-long figures from stage distributions and variants, added a year-to-date results/current-streak dataset and noted that a completed 5-run settles or trivialises the market.

findings.text: Rotation/congestion, which stage s4 says is the main regime shift, has no kept input. Audit marks soc.motivation WEAK because rotation 'is covered by lineups', but soc.lineups_pit is not an input of this archetype and no rotation index is attached (catalog has soc.rotation_index). Interaction 4 still uses soc.motivation. Yet the contract needs lineup/congestion information for a Dec-2026 fixture pile; a rotation/congestion input (days rest, midweek European game, squad depth) must be added or the gap disclosed.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Attached soc.rotation_index and soc.congestion_load to stage s4 and situational coverage (replacing WEAK soc.motivation), changed interaction 4 to injuries x rotation_index, and fixed the feed mapping (abandonment risk from fixture statuses, not injury data).

findings.text: The cup 'win' definition is still inferred: 'about 6-10% of cup ties go to shootouts' and 'changes the probability by a few relative percent per cup tie' are unsupported numerics. Also 'a streak that began late 2025 counts only from the first 2026 win' is an inference from 'in the year 2026' (reasonable, but not stated by the rules and should be CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS together with whether draws or extra-time wins break a run).
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:streak_boundary_inferred

findings.text: Nonlinearity 'persistence threshold near 0.05' and 'streak probability 1.3-2x independent' are unsupported; the unresolved item on serial correlation concedes the effect may be zero, so soc.latent_form_persistence labelled secondary with a threshold shape is overstated. soc.xg DUPLICATE_OF soc.xg_adjusted_ratings is fine, but soc.draw_propensity matters for P(win) vs P(not lose) only through the rating model; is not independent evidence.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: soc.latent_form_persistence demoted from secondary to context, nonlinearity 2 relabelled as an unsupported threshold hypothesis, and soc.draw_propensity audit changed to KEEP_CONTEXT as it acts only through the rating model.

findings.text: 'Title restricts to the men's team ... early-2026 wins before the as-of date already count' is attributed to a quote; the quote ('men's soccer') supports men's only, the second clause is an inference. Required data 'Squad availability' lists soc.abandonment_risk and soc.points_deductions as fed by injury data, a mapping error.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Corrected the KXWINSTREAKMANU evidence text (the quote supports men's team only; early-2026 wins counting is an inference) and removed soc.abandonment_risk and soc.points_deductions from the injury-data feeds (abandonment now fed by fixture statuses).

total_goals.rederivation_notes: MY CHAIN (before reading the record): sampled match-total series (KXAFCONTOTAL, KXEFLL1TOTAL, KXISRSCUPTOTAL, KXSUPERLIGTOTAL) settle 'over N goals ... after 90 minutes plus stoppage time (does not include extra time or penalties)', x.5 strikes, no ties. Chain: lambda_home/lambda_away from opponent-adjusted attack/defence and league environment -> confirmed XI attack/defence deltas -> shared openness/correlation and overdispersion -> score-effect damping and mismatch tails -> low-score dependence (Dixon-Coles) -> finishing/keeper noise, weather, referee/penalties -> ladder rung probability P(T>=k+1) with team-total variant for one side. Hazards: own goals (counted in the final score but not stated in the totals text), abandonment, ET exclusion, women's/cup/low-tier matches. Ledger also contains season/tournament aggregates in the same key (KXEPLTOTAL 'Total Goals', KXWCTOTAL/KXWCTEAMGOALS/KXWCTOTALGOAL, five Team Points series). DIFFERENCES: author's chain, new inputs (xi split, openness factor, tail dispersion), and benchmark demotions (implied_lambda, strike_hit_rates) agree with mine; I disagree with demoting low-score modelling on the strength of four sampled high strikes, and with ignoring the non-match series and with quoting rules that appear only in sibling series.

findings.text: Non-match series in this key are never mentioned: KXEPLTEAMPOINTS, KXLALIGATEAMPOINTS, KXSERIEATEAMPOINTS, KXLIGUE1TEAMPOINTS, KXBUNDESLIGATEAMPOINTS ('Team Points', full season) and aggregates such as KXEPLTOTAL ('English Premier League Total Goals'), KXWCTOTAL, KXWCTEAMGOALS, KXWCTEAMTOTAL, KXWCTOTALGOAL, KXSOCCERTOTAL. The 202-series count and the claim 'same wording across leagues' hide that these need season simulation (points distribution, remaining schedule, tournament match count), not per-match goal inputs. The input list can only be relied on for the per-match totals; these series must be routed to team_points or a new key and the gap listed in 'unresolved'.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Logged the five Team Points series (to team_points_and_margin) and the five aggregate goal series (new tournament_goal_aggregates archetype) in series_mapping_issues, scoped this record to per-match totals and team totals in variants, and added aggregate_series_routing as an unresolved gap.

findings.text: Tail-first mechanism rests on four sampled strikes (5.5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5). The evidence pack gives no information on how the sampled market was chosen or what other rungs exist; the author infers that 'rungs at 5.5-7.5 ... exist because of mismatches (cups, women's matches)' and builds a primary input (soc.total_goal_tail_dispersion) and the demotion of soc.dixon_coles_low_score to KEEP_CONTEXT on that reading. A Besiktas league match with a 5.5 strike indicates a ladder with many rungs; the central rungs (1.5-3.5), where draw/low-score structure and the mean dominate, carry most volume. Mark as MECHANISM_UNCERTAIN/CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS and keep Dixon-Coles and goal_dist at primary for lower rungs.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Marked the tail-first reading as a hypothesis, demoted soc.total_goal_tail_dispersion from primary to secondary, changed soc.dixon_coles_low_score audit from KEEP_CONTEXT to KEEP_SECONDARY (soc.goal_dist stays primary) for the central rungs, and logged ladder_rung_set_unknown.

findings.text: Settlement statements not found in the totals texts: 'Own goals count for the team awarded the goal' and 'Cancelled or rescheduled-beyond-48-hours matches settle at fair price per the generic game text'. In the evidence pack the 48-hour fair-price clause appears only in first_half_and_period series and the own-goal clause in FTTS/BTTS series; none of the four sampled totals contains either. The author hedges once ('visible in sibling game series') but states both as settlement facts and in settlement_data_source.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Reviewer correct: own-goal credit and the 48-hour fair-price clause are not in the four sampled totals texts; settlement_definition and settlement_data_source now state them as inferred from sibling series.

findings.text: KXAFCONTOTAL quote establishes 'P(6+ goals) is a deep-tail event of about 2-4%'; the figure is an unsourced estimate and is attached to a rules quote. Likewise 'variance 10-15% above Poisson', 'tail multiplier 1.5-2.5 at 6.5+' and 'wind threshold 30 km/h' are stated as facts rather than parameters to estimate.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed the 2-4% estimate from the KXAFCONTOTAL evidence text and relabelled the 10-15% overdispersion, the 1.5-2.5 tail multiplier and the 30 km/h wind threshold as placeholders to estimate.

findings.text: Interactions: xi_attack_defence_split x lineups_pit pairs a measure with its own timestamped source; xg_adjusted_ratings x openness 'multiplicative' with variance 'increases with the sum of lambdas' is stated loosely; weather x pace_press is a speculative style interaction without evidence. soc.dixon_coles_low_score and soc.goal_dist substantially overlap (both are the count-distribution machinery) but only one is labelled primary.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced interaction 2 (a measure with its own timestamped source) by xi_attack_defence_split x xg_adjusted_ratings, restated interaction 1 with the variance formula, labelled interaction 4 speculative, and stated the goal_dist/dixon_coles overlap in the audit.

findings.text: Data sources: Transfermarkt lineups are post-hoc (author flags this in lineup_vintage); API-Football (not listed here) has pre-match lineup endpoints that could serve own capture; football-data.co.uk referee columns exist only for some leagues. Understat covers six leagues, so xG-based ratings are undefined for EFL, Super Lig, Israeli, Saudi, AFCON/qualifier series that make up most of the 202; the record does not disclose which ratings fall back to goals-only (ClubElo) for those.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added the API-Football pre-match lineup endpoint as a paid source, annotated that referee columns exist only for some leagues and Understat covers six leagues, and logged xg_coverage_fallback for the goals-only fallback outside those leagues.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events.rederivation_notes: MY CHAIN (before reading the record): six live corner series, N+ strikes (floor_strike N, greater_or_equal), combined and single-team, 'entire game (regulation, stoppage and any extra time periods)'; EPL and La Liga add 'Only corner kicks that are actually taken will count', the UCL texts omit it. Chain: team attacking volume and territory -> share of attacks ending blocked/deflected/saved-and-parried, crosses and wide play -> opponent block/clearance style -> score-state redistribution (trailer wins corners late, leader concedes) -> exposure (stoppage, VAR, ET) -> overdispersed counts, positive between teams at match level via openness, negative at team level via possession/state -> rung probability. Required: team corners for/against, shots by outcome, crosses, state-conditioned corner rates, lineups for wide/aerial personnel, referee/added-time, definition flags. DIFFERENCES: record matches on chain and found the taken/awarded variance between EPL/La Liga and UCL; weaknesses are internal inconsistencies in the audit versus stages, thin personnel treatment, and unsupported numerics.

findings.text: Audit contradicts stages: soc.fouls_cards is IRRELEVANT ('Fouls and cards are not corner determinants') but Stage s4 lists soc.fouls_cards as an input ('a red card changes both teams' corner rates'); soc.set_piece_matchup is KEEP_CONTEXT ('concerns conversion of corners into goals, not counts') yet Stage s2 and category coverage use it as the opponent-matchup input for corner counts. One of the two must change; as written the input list is not consistent with the mechanism.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed the IRRELEVANT soc.fouls_cards from stage s4 and officiating cover and the KEEP_CONTEXT soc.set_piece_matchup from stage s2 and opponent_matchup cover (now crosses/wide play and formation), and dropped the set_piece_matchup feed from the rules-text row.

findings.text: role_personnel is declared NOT_APPLICABLE ('individual players matter little for team corner counts'), but corner counts for a team threshold depend on whether wide players/crossers, aerial targets and the keeper start; no lineup input is attached although lineups are timestamped pregame information and soc.lineups_pit is available. The reasoning 'no evidence in available data' is an absence of testing, not of effect.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Changed role_personnel and availability_news from NOT_APPLICABLE to COVERED by soc.lineups_pit (attached to s1, with a lineup-snapshot required_data row) and logged lineup_effect_on_corners_untested because the effect size is unknown.

findings.text: Source of truth is acknowledged only in settlement_data_source ('provider is not stated') and is not an 'unresolved' entry; provider choice decides taken vs awarded (author's own taken/awarded ratio guess '0.97-1.0' is unsourced). Required-data dataset lists football-data.co.uk HC/AC corner columns (correct) but lists 'blocked' as a field with no source that provides it among the free ones (only Understat shot-result, which the record does not name); soc.corner_generation_by_shot_outcome is therefore only defined with SOURCE_UNVERIFIED feeds.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:corner_provider_unstated

findings.text: Unsupported numerics given as mechanism: '30-40% more corners for the trailer after the 60th minute', 'ET adds 2-3 corners', 'derbies +0.5 corners', 'sd about 15% across teams', 'variance 1.2-1.4x mean'. Interaction 3 says corners saturate against very deep blocks with high possession, while stage s1 says dominant teams against deep blocks generate the highest counts; the claims conflict.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Relabelled 30-40% trailer uplift, ET corners, derby shift, 15% sd and 1.2-1.4 overdispersion as placeholders/unmeasured and reconciled interaction 3 with stage s1 (saturating marginal corners per attack, counts still rise with dominance).

findings.text: Interaction 4 (added_time x corner_taken_definition_flag, 'threshold') is not an interaction: ET inclusion is stated by every sampled text, and the 'taken' flag is a measurement definition, not a driver that interacts with exposure. Also all six sampled series are league or league-phase games where ET cannot occur, so the ET emphasis is not evidenced by these live series.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced interaction 4 (added_time x taken-definition flag, not a true interaction) with added_time x corner_state_multiplier, and added a variant noting that all six sampled series are league games where extra time cannot occur.

findings.text: Cards and fouls: contract_types list them but no live series exists (author discloses). Inputs soc.referee/fouls_cards/rivalry remain in the audit for a contract that cannot be verified; they should be marked unverified, not graded WEAK/IRRELEVANT as though tested.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Prefixed the soc.fouls_cards and soc.rivalry_intensity audit reasons with UNVERIFIED (no live cards/fouls contract) so they read as untested domain judgements rather than graded results; the cards_fouls_no_live_series unresolved entry remains.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props.rederivation_notes: MY CHAIN (before reading the record): contracts seen: Goalscorer 1+ (floor 0.5, also 5+ goals), Assists 1+/3+, Score-or-assist, First Goalscorer plus 'No Goal' outcome, and a joint First-goal-and-team-wins combo (KXINTLFRIENDLYFGW). All 'entire game incl. ET'. DNP: 'If a player is active but never enters the game, the market settles to the (last) fair market price before game start'; first-goalscorer also settles at fair price if the first goal comes before a substitute enters. Chain: matchday-squad inclusion -> starter/sub/unused mixture and entry minute -> team goal intensity for this fixture -> player share of chances x finishing + penalty duty -> Poisson thinning P=1-exp(-lambda) -> assists via creation/set-piece role and teammates' finishing -> union for score-or-assist -> first-goal competing-risk with time-on-pitch -> combo dependence with match result (win incl. any tiebreak procedure). Required: lineups point-in-time, minutes/sub model, team lambdas, player xG/xA, penalty duty, opp shot profile, referee penalties. DIFFERENCES: author matches the chain and the fair-price quotes; I add the unaddressed meaning of 'active' (a player not in the matchday squad is not covered by the refund), the shootout case in the combo, and correct some numeric claims.

findings.text: The refund rule applies only to a player who is 'active but never enters'. The record treats every DNP as refunded ('A bench player who never plays is not a loss ... removes most of the benching risk') and its stage s1 calls 'the relevant quantity ... the conditional output given he plays'. The text does not say what happens to a player who is injured, rested or not in the matchday squad (not 'active'): plausibly No or a different rule. That undefined boundary decides how much availability probability must enter the price and is missing from 'unresolved' (only the fair-price wording is listed). Mark CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS and treat squad inclusion as separate from bench-never-enters.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:inactive_vs_bench_boundary

findings.text: rules_verification is VERIFIED_FROM_RULES_TEXT but the rules_secondary sampled in the evidence pack is cut at about 600 characters for first-goalscorer series (ends 'If t...'). The author notes truncation in one unresolved item yet verifies the whole family; the own-goal, no-goal and extra-time clauses beyond the cut cannot be verified. PARTIALLY_VERIFIED is the supportable status.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:rules_secondary_truncated

findings.text: Combo KXINTLFRIENDLYFGW says the winning team 'is determined by the official match result, including any officially recognized tiebreaking procedure', so a penalty-shootout win counts as the team 'winning'. The record quotes only the first-goal sentence and treats 'wins' as a dependence on regulation score. Stage s5 also states 'about 70% of first-goal teams win-or-draw'; the first scorer wins about 70% of the time and win-or-draw is nearer 85-90%, so the figure is wrong as stated.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added the KXINTLFRIENDLYFGW quote that the winner is the official result including any tiebreaking procedure (shootout counts), and corrected stage s5 (first scorer wins about 70%, win-or-draw 85-90%, both unsourced).

findings.text: Penalty magnitudes are inconsistent: s3 says taker adds '0.1-0.2 goals per match', interaction 3 says penalty awarded probability '0.25-0.3 per match', audit says 'penalty about 0.3 per match'. About 0.3 penalties per match is the match total for both sides; a single team gets roughly 0.15, so the taker's extra scoring chance is about 0.1-0.12 per match. Nonlinearity 'lambda 0.3 to 0.6 raises P by about 0.15' is about 0.19.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Made penalty magnitudes consistent (0.15 per team, 0.3 per match both teams, taker adds about 0.1 goals/match), relabelled interaction 3 multiplicative, and corrected nonlinearity 1 arithmetic (P 0.26 to 0.45, +0.19).

findings.text: Interaction 2 (xg_adjusted_ratings x player_shot_share, 'multiplicative') is the definition lambda = team lambda x share, not an interaction; interaction 1 (dnp_and_sub_entry_settlement x player_xg) re-states minutes weighting. Interaction 3 (taker x penalty_rate) is a product, not a threshold.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced interaction 1 (minutes weighting restated) with a minutes x team-lambda state-conditional interaction and interaction 2 (the definition lambda = team x share) with player_shot_share x opponent zone concession; interaction 3 already relabelled multiplicative.

findings.text: Series with unusual structure fall into this archetype without inputs for them: KXINTLFRIENDLYFGW (joint outcome with match winner needs P(team scores first AND wins), not stated as an input), 3+ assist and 5+ goal rungs in friendlies (tails). Many named players in samples are depth players with tiny samples (Aitor Manas, Karetsas, Nwaneri); the record's position-mean shrinkage is mentioned but no prior for academy/youth players or newly promoted squads is defined.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:combo_and_depth_priors

unreg:player_shots_saves_props.rederivation_notes: MY CHAIN (before reading the record): evidence pack shows live_series = [] and no rules samples, so no contract text exists; I only reason from sport knowledge. A player shots / shots-on-target prop would be: squad inclusion, starter/sub minutes -> team shot volume vs this opponent (tempo, state, block rate) -> player share by role and set pieces/penalties -> accuracy (SOT vs blocked/off target by provider definition) -> game-state multipliers -> count thinning with overdispersion; goalkeeper saves = SOT faced - goals conceded (penalty and own-goal details by provider), driven by opponent SOT volume, shot quality and the actual score path, non-monotone in opponent strength. Settlement hazards (unverifiable): blocked shots counted, penalties, ET, DNP rule, provider definitions. Required inputs: lineups point-in-time, minutes model, team shots/SOT, player shot share, state response, keeper workload and PSxG, definition mapping. DIFFERENCES: the record agrees on the mechanism and honestly marks NO_LIVE_SERIES; weaknesses: it still assigns primary/secondary roles with specifics as if tested, one new input duplicates an existing one, and a rotation input available in the catalog is left out.

findings.text: Nothing in this record can be validated against a contract: there is no live series and no rules text. KEEP_PRIMARY/KEEP_SECONDARY verdicts, numeric claims (team shots mean 12 sd 4, SOT 33%, 30% of SOT to goals, saves mean 3 sd 1.7, 20-40% trailer uplift) and the list of required datasets are all domain assumptions. The record discloses the absence of a series but then grades inputs as if verified; the archetype should be treated as a hypothetical template and not as evidence that Kalshi lists shots/saves props.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Labelled the archetype a HYPOTHETICAL TEMPLATE in settlement_definition and summary, prefixed every input_audit reason with PROVISIONAL, relabelled the numeric claims as placeholders and logged hypothetical_template_only; no claim of a listed contract remains.

findings.text: soc.keeper_saves_from_sot_and_psxg duplicates the existing soc.keeper_workload: the catalog measurement of keeper_workload is already 'Expected SOT faced ... multiply by shrunk save probability (PSxG-based)'; both are marked primary and interaction 2 pairs them with each other. One should be DUPLICATE_OF the other.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Demoted soc.keeper_saves_from_sot_and_psxg to secondary and stated it extends (is not independent of) soc.keeper_workload, replaced interaction 2 that paired the two with keeper_workload x opp_shot_profile_by_zone, and corrected nonlinearity 1 (monotone at fixed conversion).

findings.text: The catalog already has soc.rotation_index and soc.penalty_rate which would address the declared GAP on early substitution and penalties (used in the goal/assist archetype), but this record neither attaches nor audits them; the 'no stakes or rotation input attached' gap is therefore self-inflicted rather than a real absence.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Attached soc.rotation_index to stage s1 and soc.penalty_rate to stage s4 (with a referee/penalty required_data row and rotation feed), changed situational and officiating coverage accordingly and removed the self-inflicted gap_situational_schedule_motivation entry.

findings.text: Interaction 3 (lineups_pit x player_minutes_expectation, 'threshold') is participation gating rather than a mechanism between two inputs; interaction 2 non-monotone saves is plausible but not demonstrated (saves = SOT x (1 - conversion) is monotone in SOT at fixed conversion).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced interaction 3 (participation gating, not a mechanism between two inputs) with minutes x state-response conditional interaction, and rewrote interaction 2 and nonlinearity 1 so saves are not claimed non-monotone without a demonstration.

findings.text: Source claims: Understat has team and player shots with results but no goalkeeper saves/PSxG, so the keeper dataset has no free source with the claimed fields (FBref is flagged SOURCE_UNVERIFIED and StatsBomb is paid); 'football-data.co.uk team shots and SOT' is correct but team-only. Whether any free source gives saves by match for non-top-6 leagues is unaddressed.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:keeper_saves_free_source

findings.text: Definition of saves/shots not fixed by any text (blocked shots, penalty saves, deflections, whether a block counts as a shot on target); the proposed soc.shot_event_definition_mapping needs two providers' counts for 200+ matches, which is not obtainable from the free sources listed, so the input is likely undefined in practice.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:shot_definition_mapping_infeasible
